Third-Party Component Notice

This product includes the following third-party software component,
distributed under its own open-source license.

Component : Mermaid
Version   : 10.9.1
Purpose   : Offline, browser-local diagram rendering (flowcharts) used by the
            TM1 Insight visual workbench. Loaded entirely from local static
            assets; no network requests are made to any remote service.
File      : vendor/mermaid.min.js
Source    : https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid
